---
title: "Home"
---

I am a senior postdoctoral researcher with a background in electrical/biomedical engineering and computer engineering. I work in the [Talent and Learning Research](https://begabungsforschung.uni-graz.at/en/) group at the [Department of Psychology](https://psychologie.uni-graz.at/en/) at the [University of Graz](https://www.uni-graz.at/en/), Austria.

My research focuses on the neuroscientific foundations of number processing and arithmetic, EEG oscillations and connectivity analysis, biomedical signal processing, applied machine learning and statistics, brain-computer interfaces, and scientific software development. I am strongly committed to open science and open source, including the open availability of data and analysis code to promote reproducibility. In addition, I have extensive experience teaching Python and R in academic settings, including courses and workshops on data analysis, statistics, and scientific computing.

I maintain and develop several open-source projects, most notably:

- [MNELAB](https://github.com/cbrnr/mnelab) – a graphical user interface for EEG/MEG data processing
- [SleepECG](https://github.com/cbrnr/sleepecg) – a Python package for ECG-based sleep staging
- [HeartBeats.jl](https://github.com/cbrnr/HeartBeats.jl) – a Julia implementation of the Pan-Tompkins R-peak detection algorithm
- [XDF.jl](https://github.com/cbrnr/XDF.jl) – a Julia package for reading [XDF](https://github.com/sccn/xdf/wiki/Specifications) files
- [SigViewer](https://github.com/cbrnr/sigviewer) – a Qt/C++-based tool for biosignal visualization
- [SCoT](https://github.com/scot-dev/scot) – a Python package for EEG source connectivity estimation

In addition, I am a member of the development teams for several open-source projects, notably [MNE-Python](https://mne.tools), [pybv](https://github.com/bids-standard/pybv), and [pyxdf](https://github.com/xdf-modules/pyxdf). I have also contributed to a range of other projects, including [scikit-learn](http://scikit-learn.org/stable/), [pandas](https://pandas.pydata.org/), [IPython](https://ipython.org/), [PsychoPy](http://www.psychopy.org/), [SciPy](https://www.scipy.org/), [Matplotlib](https://matplotlib.org/), and [BioSig](http://biosig.sourceforge.net/), among others.

You can find my recent work and activity on [GitHub](https://github.com/cbrnr) and [Mastodon](https://scholar.social/@cbrnr){rel="me"}. Feel free to contact me via [email](mailto:clemens.brunner@gmail.com) if you want to get in touch.
